reviews.title: Hate the update
reviews.text:
Since this was updated, you have to resize the before and after pics individually, making it hard to get them the same size and proportion. When you could resize them just using the pinch gesture while viewing both photos in the frame, it was way better. You can't even adjust the cropping once you've done it the first time. All you can do is double tap, choose the photo again, crop it again, and hope you got it just right this time. Makes no sense. 
Also the new captions take up SO much space now that they're on top of the photo. The point of the app is to see details in the photo, and the obscuring caption makes that much harder. 
If the app stays this way, I'm finding another one.
